title: Professional Certificate Course in Interaction of Media Society and Strategic Communication
description: The aim of this course is to provide students with an understanding of the complex and dynamic relationship between media, society, and strategic communication.
longDescription: Understand Strategic Communication by exploring the development of the Advertising Industry. Explore the User Dependency on Media Institutions. Explore the concept of Media Convergence. Understand Mass media and Popular Culture. Understand the Role of Social Values in Communication and The Effect on our Lives – Media Transformation Including Cultivation Theory, Functionalism, Agenda Setting, Uses and Gratifications Theory, and Social Learning. Understand Media Literacy. Understand Advertising in Contemporary Culture. Analyze the Future of Advertising. Analyze the Business of Public Relations The aim of the "Interaction of Media, Society and Strategic Communication" course is to provide students with an understanding of the complex and dynamic relationship between media, society, and strategic communication. courseDetails: The course covers the ways in which media and communication shape public opinion, attitudes, and behavior, and how organizations and institutions can use communication strategies to influence these outcomes. Students will learn about the role of media in shaping social and cultural norms, promoting social change, and influencing political processes, as well as the ethical and legal issues associated with strategic communication. The course will also explore the impact of new media technologies and platforms on the relationship between media, society, and strategic communication, and the ways in which organizations can use these tools to reach and engage with audiences.

workshops: CEO, Director, Manager, Supervisor Public Relations Specialists Marketing Professionals Advertising Executives Communications Managers Social Media Strategists Government Affairs Specialists Nonprofit Communications Directors Media Relations Managers Brand Managers Corporate Communications Directors. There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
